groups.provided-assignment: The exact BibTeX input from an original assignment test; it must parse. Test bodies and assertions are unchanged.
groups.regression-valid: Curated valid examples must parse; bibliography facts are not part of this assertion.
groups.regression-invalid: Malformed or disallowed whole responses must be rejected, not crash the parser.
groups.nesting-valid: Balanced groups at the named depth must parse.
groups.nesting-invalid: The matching nested example with its final closing brace removed must be rejected.
groups.document-size-valid: All entries in the named document size must parse.
groups.document-size-invalid: Removing the last closing brace leaves the final entry incomplete and must be rejected.
groups.value-length-valid: A quoted value with the named character count must parse, including an empty value.
groups.value-length-invalid: The matching long value without its closing quote must be rejected.
groups.feature-interactions: Combines 4 nesting depths, 3 value formats, 2 outer delimiters, and 2 trailing-comma choices.
groups.every-prefix-truncation: Every incomplete prefix of one 58-character entry is rejected; none contains a complete earlier entry.
groups.semantic-limits-accepted: Syntactically valid input is accepted even when facts, required fields, or macro definitions are questionable.
groups.documented-out-of-scope: These are legitimate general BibTeX constructs outside this supported subset; rejection records scope, not invalid BibTeX.
groups.lexical-boundary: ASCII whitespace must not silently split a citation key or field name.
groups.unicode-content: Non-breaking and thin spaces inside a field value are literal content and must be accepted.

requirements.R3: Special characters, LaTeX, and Unicode content
requirements.R6: Robustness extension: reject malformed or incomplete responses
requirements.S1: Semantic boundary: syntax does not verify citation facts
requirements.S2: Declared scope: BibTeX features outside the citation subset
